verdict.rationale: The pack only shows bare page titles for an Alerts product (sentry-docs-17), Issue Status/triage states (sentry-docs-20) and Releases (sentry-docs-16), plus Slack and PagerDuty notification integrations (sentry-docs-18, sentry-docs-19). Together these suggest release-aware issue states could drive alerts. However, nothing in the pack explicitly describes regression detection or a regression-specific alert. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that resolved issues are flagged as regressed when they recur in a newer release, a regression-specific alert condition distinct from new-issue alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
